capability_gate_order: exact current method+path contract is available or separately revalidated
exact method+path is granted by current account /v1/roles
safe response projection/privacy gate is implemented
subscription-specific restrictions are handled from provider result without guessed substitution
invariants: one explicit Bridge command = at most one external business request
no arbitrary URL, host, method, headers or credentials
no customer PII in LLM results or logs
generated report create/status/retrieve are separate explicit operations
no provider quota/timer/cache/history reset as an implementation mechanism
no Autorun changes in this coverage milestone

clusters.catalog_products: Product list/info, attributes, descriptions, pictures, rich content and read-only product diagnostics.
clusters.stocks_inventory: Aggregate stock, stock analytics and warehouse-level FBO/FBS stock reads.
clusters.warehouse_cluster_logistics: Warehouses, clusters and seller logistics reference/configuration reads.
clusters.sales_analytics: Seller analytics other than stock and search.
clusters.prices_promotions: Product prices and read-only promotion/action information.
clusters.orders_postings: FBO/FBS/FBP posting and assembly reads; privacy-sensitive rows remain blocked/gated.
clusters.supplies_fbo: Supply orders, supply status and read-only FBO supply/draft/cargo reference data.
clusters.returns_cancellations: Cancel reasons, cancellation status and safe/gated return reads.
clusters.finance_settlement: Accruals, balance, realization and seller financial reads.
clusters.reports_exports: Report create/list/info workflows with explicit multi-step semantics.
clusters.delivery_fbs_diagnostics: Delivery methods, carriage reads, FBS error index and operational diagnostics.
clusters.reviews_questions: Aggregate/safe review and question data; content-bearing records are privacy blocked.
clusters.certification_reference: Certificate types, statuses, lists and certification reference reads.
clusters.seller_settings_reference: Read-only seller/FBS settings and management information.
clusters.customer_communications: Customer communication surfaces; content remains privacy blocked by default.
clusters.reference_data: Neutral reference/status reads not naturally owned by another cluster.
clusters.advertising_performance: Separate Performance API provider; not part of Seller /v1/roles accounting.

premium_policy.rule: Do not suppress an exact role-granted endpoint solely because its OpenAPI section is Premium. /v1/roles is the account-specific reachability signal; concrete metrics, dimensions, history periods or fields may still be subscription-limited at runtime.

stock_inventory_priority.history_rule: Bridge guidance absence is not evidence of upstream impossibility. Search current report, finance, supply and movement contracts before concluding that exact historical stock-at-date is unavailable.
